quiz.question: What is the primary focus of the D.R.Y principle in programming?

answers.answer: Ensuring each piece of knowledge exists in a single, unambiguous place
Creating as many functions as possible

quiz.question: How does adhering to the D.R.Y principle benefit a codebase?

answers.answer: It makes the codebase more complex
It ensures the code is less readable
It reduces potential errors and improves maintainability
It increases the size of the codebase

quiz.question: Which example best illustrates the application of the D.R.Y principle?

answers.answer: Copying the same function multiple times throughout the codebase
Integrating repeated logic in a single function to be reused
Writing out variable declarations repeatedly across different files
Duplicating configurations in multiple locations for easy access
